advisories.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption in io.undertow:undertow-core
advisories.description: Affected versions of io.undertow:undertow-core are vulnerable to Uncontrolled Resource Consumption. Under specific conditions during an HTTP upgrade to a remoting connection, Undertow fails to clean up a timeout task when a connection is abruptly closed. This results in lingering references in the worker thread, leading to both memory and file descriptor leaks that can exhaust server resources. An attacker could repeatedly open and close connections to trigger resource exhaustion and potentially cause a denial-of-service.
